newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends near highs, poised for rally.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends near highs, poised for rally.

text.p: March CSCE world sugar futures settled sharply higher, lifted by aggressive trade buying in the March/May spread and shortcovering later in the session, dealers said.

The benchmark March contract climbed to a day's high of 10.45 cents a lb once stops were triggered just above 10.40. The buying encountered stiff point-by-point producer selling, which capped the rally.
March ended up 0.20 at 10.44, while the back months closed 0.14 to 0.12 firmer.
"If the funds were buying in a vacuum, it could have run up another 20 points," a trader said.

Dealers agree today's close positions March sugar to test firmer resistance at a gap between 10.47 and 10.50 cents, on Tuesday. If stops are pierced above that level, some players may be forced to cover short positions.
One trader said producers could also raise selling limits, allowing prices to run up without opposition.
Open interest in March continued to grow over the past several sessions when the contract traded to a recent low of 10.10 cents, suggesting new fund selling, a floor source said.
